description: This file defines the TipsViewHolder class for a RecyclerView, responsible for binding Tip models to views, handling display and click actions for tip items in the Android app.

classes.name: TipsViewHolder
classes.description: A ViewHolder for displaying tip items in a RecyclerView, binding the TipsModel data to UI elements and handling user interactions.

methods.name: TipsViewHolder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the ViewHolder with a view and binding it.

methods.name: bind
methods.description: Binds a TipsModel to the ViewHolder's views, setting text, visibility, and click behavior based on the tip data.
